stages.en_note: Freeze the v0.2 development line so protocol changes are made against an explicit internal baseline rather than ad-hoc edits.
stages.ru_note: Зафиксировать линию разработки v0.2, чтобы изменения протокола шли по внутренней утверждённой базе, а не через случайные правки.
en_details: Legacy Devnet v0.1 remains frozen for regression checks
ru_details: Legacy Devnet v0.1 остаётся замороженным для regression-проверок

stages.en_note: Replace the early flat persistence model with indexed, atomic blockchain storage and a verified migration path.
stages.ru_note: Заменить раннее плоское хранение на индексированное атомарное blockchain storage и проверяемую миграцию.
en_details: Atomic block, height, tx, UTXO, undo and metadata indexes
Database identity bound to network and Genesis
ru_details: Атомарные индексы block, height, tx, UTXO, undo и metadata
База привязана к network и Genesis

stages.en_note: Separate Devnet/Testnet identities and introduce the second-generation VALDR wire protocol.
stages.ru_note: Разделить идентичности Devnet/Testnet и внедрить вторую версию сетевого протокола VALDR.
en_details: Separate legacy, devnet2 and testnet profiles
ru_details: Отдельные legacy, devnet2 и testnet profiles
P2P framing с checksum и лимитами

stages.en_note: Move from a simple height-oriented chain to real cumulative-work fork choice with reversible state transitions.
stages.ru_note: Перейти от простой цепи по высоте к выбору ветки по cumulative work с обратимыми изменениями состояния.

stages.en_note: Make Proof-of-Work target transitions and block-time validation deterministic across nodes.
stages.ru_note: Сделать изменение Proof-of-Work target и проверку времени блока детерминированными на всех нодах.

stages.en_note: Add real transaction fees and hard consensus limits for transaction and block size.
stages.ru_note: Добавить реальные transaction fees и жёсткие consensus limits для размера транзакций и блоков.
en_details: Miner claims subsidy plus selected fees
ru_details: Miner получает subsidy плюс выбранные fees

stages.en_note: Turn the pending-transaction pool into bounded policy-controlled state and make block template selection deterministic.
stages.ru_note: Сделать pending transaction pool ограниченным policy-state и детерминировать выбор транзакций майнером.
en_details: Fee-rate based eviction and mining order
ru_details: Eviction и mining order по fee rate

stages.en_note: Let a fresh or restarted node catch up safely by validating headers before downloading block bodies.
stages.ru_note: Научить новую или перезапущенную ноду безопасно догонять сеть, проверяя headers до загрузки тел блоков.
en_details: Restart resume and heavier-branch reorg sync
ru_details: Проверка header до загрузки block body
Resume после restart и reorg на более тяжёлую ветку

stages.en_note: Add bootstrap support and harden the P2P layer against malformed, abusive or excessive traffic.
stages.ru_note: Добавить bootstrap и усилить P2P-слой против malformed, abusive и excessive traffic.
en_details: Compiled seed-list support and operator overrides

stages.en_note: Move wallet private-key storage from plaintext legacy files to authenticated encryption.
stages.ru_note: Перевести хранение private key из plaintext legacy wallet в authenticated encryption.
en_details: No plaintext private key in new wallet files
Legacy wallet migration and signing gate
ru_details: В новых wallet-файлах нет plaintext private key
Migration legacy wallet и signing gate

stages.en_note: Build a separate read-only service for blocks, transactions, addresses and network status without giving it consensus authority.
stages.ru_note: Создать отдельный read-only service для блоков, транзакций, адресов и network status без consensus-прав.
en_details: No signing, mining or privileged RPC controls
ru_details: Нет signing, mining или privileged RPC controls

stages.en_note: Turn the protocol into a repeatable Testnet runtime that can be deployed, restarted, mined and verified on real infrastructure.
stages.ru_note: Превратить протокол в повторяемый Testnet runtime, который можно deploy, restart, mine и verify на реальной инфраструктуре.
en_details: Docker image with node, CLI, miner and Explorer
Linux systemd deployment, backup, restore and verify procedures
CI mines a real Testnet block and synchronizes it across nodes
ru_details: Docker image с node, CLI, miner и Explorer
Linux systemd deployment, backup, restore и verify procedures
CI майнит реальный Testnet block и синхронизирует его между nodes

stages.en_note: Desktop work is already present and CI-green in valdr-v0.2. The website treats the stage as in development until the product gate is formally completed.
stages.ru_note: Desktop-код уже есть в valdr-v0.2 и проходит CI. Сайт помечает этап как «в разработке», пока product gate официально не завершён.
en_details: Wails v2 application shell and original VALDR visual system
Managed canonical valdrd backend with outbound-only P2P mode
Cross-platform data paths and graceful managed shutdown
Encrypted wallet bridge, balance, Send and Receive flows
Fee preview and fee-aware Testnet send
Read-only sync progress from peer heights
Blocking first-run Testnet wallet setup flow
ru_details: Wails v2 application shell и собственная VALDR visual system
Managed canonical valdrd backend с outbound-only P2P mode
Cross-platform data paths и graceful managed shutdown
Encrypted wallet bridge, balance, Send и Receive
Fee preview и fee-aware Testnet send
Read-only sync progress по peer heights
Blocking first-run Testnet wallet setup flow

stages.en_note: Package VALDR Desktop for normal users and connect every artifact to a verifiable release pipeline.
stages.ru_note: Упаковать VALDR Desktop для обычного пользователя и связать каждый artifact с проверяемым release pipeline.
en_details: Release notes bound to source commit
ru_details: Release notes с привязкой к source commit

stages.en_note: Move from local/container Testnet validation to stable public infrastructure with real seed nodes and soak gates.
stages.ru_note: Перейти от local/container Testnet к стабильной публичной инфраструктуре с реальными seed nodes и soak gates.
en_details: At least 3 stable public full nodes

stages.en_note: Define Mainnet separately only after the Testnet product and operational gates provide enough evidence for final network parameters.
stages.ru_note: Определять Mainnet отдельно только после того, как Testnet product и operational gates дадут достаточно данных для финальных network parameters.
en_details: Final Mainnet network profile and Genesis
Launch only after its own verification gates
ru_details: Финальный Mainnet network profile и Genesis
Запуск только после собственных verification gates
